steps.name: Install pinned validation and bindings
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Build and execute signed C and Rust capability packages
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
python3 tools/build_guest_capsules.py --output "$LSF_GUEST_CAPSULES" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-guest-build.log"
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test guest_sdk -- --ignored --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-guest-runtime.log"
cargo test --locked -p latent-signing --test guest_provenance 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-guest-provenance.log"
cargo test --locked -p latent-control-store --lib managed_lease_failure_never_mutates_or_renews_a_historical_replay 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-guest-control-lease.log"
cargo test --locked -p latent-policy --lib mutation_renewal_persists_a_full_window_even_before_the_sampler_margin 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-guest-clock-window.log"

steps.name: Qualify standalone C projects and the printed guide
Qualify captured C libraries with enforced compiler isolation
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
LSF_REQUIRE_COMPILER_ISOLATION=1 python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_c_application_dependencies tools.tests.test_c_static_symbols tools.tests.test_captured_compiler_isolation tools.tests.test_application_dependency_tools
python3 tools/qualify_c_capsules.py --application-dependencies --static-application-dependencies --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-application-library"

steps.name: Qualify actual C archive and isolated generated-header rejection controls
Retain compiler and ownership results including failures

with.name: c-guest-ownership-${{ github.run_id }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/c-guest-*.log
${{ runner.temp }}/c-guest-capsules/BUILD-COMPLETE.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-guest-capsules/c-*/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-capsule-authoring/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-capsule-authoring/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-capsule-authoring/builds/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-capsule-authoring/node/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-capsule-authoring/releases/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-capsule-authoring/guide/guide.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-capsule-authoring/guide/guide.sh
${{ runner.temp }}/c-capsule-authoring/guide/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-capsule-authoring/guide/projects/results/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-application-library/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-dependency-controls/**

reviewReason: Preserve historical C gates and run actual archive/generated-header denials plus generator cleanup controls with retained failure artifacts
